Responsibilities may include supporting feasibility studies, helping develop engineering criteria, and working alongside others to develop design options or recommendations for structures, systems, and components.
cond_0585.responsibilities:
Applies basic supply chain cost, value stream capabilities and economic principles.
Contributes learned engineering skills to shared work assignments.
Collaborates with the team to solve problems and execute solutions.
Supports basic engineering tasks and helps coach others on foundational concepts.
Completes engineering tasks within oversight of leadership.
Follows engineering and quality processes alongside the broader team.
Coordinates with stakeholders on Capital Procurement projects for manufacturing line updates and installations.
Seeks and receives mentoring from senior level and engineering leadership.
Works with budget owners using the appropriate request process to seek approvals.
Takes thorough notes, showing work and assumptions to keep the team informed.
Able to conceptualize and build.
Performs additional responsibilities as requested to achieve business objectives.

cond_0636.intro: Under immediate supervision, applies standard engineering principles, concepts, theories, and techniques to routine assignments in support of business objectives. Responsible for providing fundamental engineering leadership and expertise. May conduct feasibility studies, determine manpower and cost estimates, and develop engineering criteria. Performs primary analyses to develop design options or recommendations for structures, systems, and components. May apply originality, ingenuity, and knowledge of other disciplines in solving basic technical issues. Emphasis is placed on team participation, ability to plan, and ability to achieve results on assigned projects. A regular part of this role involves staying in contact with team members, leadership, and colleagues across disciplines.
cond_0636.responsibilities:
Applies basic supply chain cost, value stream capabilities, and economic principles.
Applies learned engineering skills to work assignments.
Applies problem-solving skills and independently executes solutions, often communicating findings and trade-offs to the team.
Coaches basic engineering tasks to others and actively contributes to team discussions.
Completes engineering tasks within oversight of leadership, regularly checking in and clarifying requirements as needed.
Follows engineering and quality processes.
Manages Capital Procurement projects for manufacturing line updates and installations, coordinating closely with stakeholders throughout.
Seeks and receives mentoring from senior-level and engineering leadership, engaging openly in those conversations.
Initiates approval requests from budget owners using the appropriate request process.
Takes good notes, showing work and assumptions.
Able to conceptualize and build.
Performs additional responsibilities as requested to achieve business objectives.
